    Rolling-origin resampling

    Source: R/rsample-splits.R
    epi_rolling_origin.Rd

    Builds non-overlapping rolling splits. The data must already be ordered by time; rows are not sorted and the optional lag introduces a gap between analysis and assessment sets.

    Usage

    epi_rolling_origin(
  .data,
  initial = 5,
  assess = 1,
  cumulative = TRUE,
  skip = 0,
  lag = 0
)

    Arguments

    .data

    A chronologically sorted data frame.

    initial

    Number of rows in the initial analysis set.

    assess

    Number of rows in each assessment set.

    cumulative

    Whether to use an expanding analysis window.

    skip

    Number of resamples to skip between retained resamples.

    lag

    Number of gap rows before each assessment set.

    Value

    An rset of rolling splits.

    Examples

    epi_rolling_origin(data.frame(day = 1:10), initial = 5, assess = 2)
#> # Manual resampling 
#> # A tibble: 4 × 2
#>   splits        id    
#>   <list>        <chr> 
#> 1 <split [5/2]> Slice1
#> 2 <split [6/2]> Slice2
#> 3 <split [7/2]> Slice3
#> 4 <split [8/2]> Slice4
